rule_name: Design System Consistency - Evolution Without Guide

checkboxes.description: Same color codes reused across all pages (no new arbitrary colors added)

evidence.reasoning: Centralized gradient colors defined in styles.tsx and reused across Dashboard (KPI cards) and Tools page (status badges). No new arbitrary color codes introduced in Tools or Analytics pages.
evidence.snippet:
export const gradients = {
  green:  'from-green-400 to-emerald-600',
  orange: 'from-orange-400 to-red-500',
  pink:   'from-pink-400 to-rose-600',
  blue:   'from-blue-400 to-indigo-600',
  purple: 'from-violet-400 to-purple-600',
} as const

evidence.reasoning: Status badge colors centralized and reused identically in ToolsTable (Dashboard) and ToolCard (Tools page). Same gradient values maintained across all pages.
CSS custom properties defined once and used consistently across all pages via Tailwind classes (dark:bg-primary-dark, dark:bg-secondary-dark, dark:bg-tertiary-dark). No new color codes added.

checkboxes.description: Typography (sizes, weights, line-heights) identical across pages

evidence.reasoning: Dashboard page uses text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold for main heading with consistent responsive sizing pattern.
evidence.snippet: Internal Tools Dashboard

evidence.reasoning: Tools page maintains identical typography pattern: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold for main heading. Same font sizes and weights as Dashboard.
Inter font family defined globally and used consistently across all pages. Font weights (400, 500, 600, 700) maintained throughout without introducing new fonts.

checkboxes.description: Spacing values from Day 6 maintained in Tools/Analytics pages

evidence.reasoning: Dashboard uses responsive spacing: px-4 md:px-10 (mobile-first padding) and my-6 md:my-10 (responsive vertical margins) establishing the baseline pattern.
evidence.snippet: <div className="px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10 flex flex-col gap-6 md:gap-8">

evidence.reasoning: Tools page maintains identical spacing pattern from Dashboard: px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10. Consistent gap-6 spacing shows proper evolution.
evidence.snippet: <div className="px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10 flex flex-col gap-6">

evidence.reasoning: Analytics page breaks spacing consistency: uses px-10 my-10 (desktop-only) instead of responsive px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10 pattern. Missing mobile breakpoints that Dashboard and Tools have. Partial compliance - awarded 2/4 points for maintaining some spacing values but losing responsive evolution.

checkboxes.description: Components (buttons, cards, badges) reused without modifications

evidence.reasoning: Header component defined once and reused across all pages via __root.tsx layout. No modifications or duplications between pages - strict reuse maintained.
ToolIcon component reused identically in ToolsTable (Dashboard) and ToolCard (Tools page). Same props interface, same styling (w-8 h-8 rounded-lg), no modifications.

Pagination buttons use identical styling pattern across Dashboard and Tools pages: same classes (px-3 py-1 cursor-pointer rounded-lg disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700), same hover states, same disabled states. Component pattern strictly reused.
evidence.snippet:
<button className="px-3 py-1 cursor-pointer rounded-lg disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700">
  <ArrowLeft />
</button>

checkboxes.description: Grid layouts and structural patterns consistent with Dashboard

evidence.reasoning: Both Dashboard and Tools pages use identical container layout pattern: flex flex-col with consistent padding (px-4 md:px-10) and margins (my-6 md:my-10). Same responsive breakpoints (md:) maintained.
evidence.snippet: <div className="px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10 flex flex-col gap-6 md:gap-8">

evidence.reasoning: Dashboard KPI section uses responsive grid: 1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet (sm:), 4 cols desktop (xl:). Establishes grid pattern that Tools page follows.
evidence.snippet: <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6">

evidence.reasoning: Tools page grid follows same responsive pattern: 1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet (sm:), 3 cols desktop (lg:). Consistent grid structure with Dashboard - same breakpoint strategy, same gap spacing.

checkboxes.description: No visual ruptures or inconsistencies between pages (smooth experience)

evidence.reasoning: Cards maintain consistent visual patterns: rounded-xl, shadow-sm, dark mode variants. Smooth transition between Dashboard KPI cards and Tools catalog cards. Minor variation: p-6 vs p-5 padding, but overall visual consistency maintained without jarring breaks.
evidence.snippet: className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white text-gray-700 shadow-sm dark:bg-tertiary-dark dark:text-white dark:shadow-gray-700"

evidence.reasoning: Page headers follow consistent pattern: same typography (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold), same spacing. Tools page adds action button but maintains visual hierarchy. No jarring transitions between pages.
evidence.snippet: Internal Tools Dashboard

evidence.reasoning: Analytics page is minimal (placeholder only) but uses similar container structure (flex flex-col gap-6). However, missing responsive breakpoints (px-10 my-10 instead of px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10) creates slight visual break from Dashboard/Tools pattern. Deducted 1 point for this inconsistency.

reasoning: The candidate demonstrated strong design system consistency across Dashboard and Tools pages by centralizing colors, gradients, and status styles in src/lib/styles.tsx and reusing them without modification. Typography remained consistent with Inter font and identical heading patterns (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold). Components like Header, ToolIcon, and pagination buttons were strictly reused without modifications. Layout patterns followed consistent responsive grid structures. However, the Analytics page introduced a spacing inconsistency by using desktop-only values (px-10 my-10) instead of the responsive pattern (px-4 md:px-10 my-6 md:my-10) established in Dashboard and Tools, breaking the mobile-first approach. This resulted in a minor visual break and partial compliance on spacing evolution. Overall, the candidate maintained excellent design consistency on Days 6-7 and mostly on Day 8, with only the spacing regression on Analytics page preventing full marks.
